_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "birth_year" INTEGER NULL, "occupation" TEXT NULL, "income_bracket" TEXT NULL, "monthly_net_income_paise" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "institution" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "last4" TEXT NULL, "upi_handles" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "sms_sender_ids" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "import_batches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "adapter" TEXT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "period_from" TEXT NULL, "period_to" TEXT NULL, "parsed_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "failed_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "duplicate_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "matched_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "errors" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "source_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "batch_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES import_batches (id), "dedupe_hash" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "parse_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "parsed" TEXT NULL, "raw_text" TEXT NULL, "sender" TEXT NULL, "received_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "spend_class" TEXT NOT NULL, "spend_class_source" TEXT NOT NULL, "floor_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "icon" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_token" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_system" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_system" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "category_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "match" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "hit_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "miss_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_paise" > 0), "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "channel" TEXT NOT NULL, "counterparty_name" TEXT NULL, "merchant_key" TEXT NULL, "vpa" TEXT NULL, "counterparty_kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', "upi_ref" TEXT NULL, "bank_ref" TEXT NULL, "card_last4" TEXT NULL, "description_raw" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "categorized_by" TEXT NULL, "categorization_rule_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES category_rules (id), "categorization_confidence" REAL NULL, "flow" TEXT NOT NULL, "flow_reason" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'direction', "transfer_pair_id" TEXT NULL, "reconciliation_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transaction_sources" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), "source_record_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES source_records (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("transaction_id", "kind"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reconciliation_reviews" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), "candidate_record_ids" TEXT NOT NULL, "score" REAL NOT NULL, "reasons" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "status" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "training_labels" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "previous_category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "features" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "limit_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("limit_paise" > 0), "warn_at_percent" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[80,100]', "effective_from" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("target_paise" > 0), "saved_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deadline" TEXT NOT NULL, "funding_rule" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_series" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "merchant_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "cadence" TEXT NOT NULL, "typical_amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "next_expected_date" TEXT NULL, "transaction_ids" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_state" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "insights" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "facts" TEXT NOT NULL, "guideline_ids" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "ai_narrative" TEXT NULL, "ai_provider" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "proposals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "target" TEXT NOT NULL, "patch" TEXT NOT NULL, "before" TEXT NOT NULL, "after" TEXT NOT NULL, "rationale" TEXT NOT NULL, "proposer" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_versions" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "expires_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "decided_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_extensions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "data" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "event" TEXT NOT NULL, "actor" TEXT NOT NULL, "proposal_id" TEXT NULL, "diff" TEXT NULL, "prev_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "hash" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ai_requests" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "feature" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider" TEXT NOT NULL, "model" TEXT NOT NULL, "fields_sent" TEXT NOT NULL, "token_count" INTEGER NULL, "outcome" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX transactions_local_date ON transactions (local_date)
CREATE INDEX transactions_category ON transactions (category_id)
CREATE INDEX transactions_upi_ref ON transactions (upi_ref)
CREATE INDEX transactions_amount_date ON transactions (amount_paise, local_date)
CREATE INDEX transactions_account_date ON transactions (account_id, local_date)
